feature_contracts.scope: static interface binding; behavioral results are verified separately

requirements.requirement: Expose a firmware-visible CSR/MMIO interface with address, write-data, read-data, transaction-valid/write-enable, and ready/response semantics.
Implement the required model transport direction contract with request valid/data outputs, request ready input, response valid/data inputs, and response ready output.
Provide bounded actuator-command behavior and inhibit validity on invalid, stale, timeout, reset, or fault conditions.
Interface with the technology-neutral history memory wrapper for bulk payload and event storage.
Maintain latched fault state for software handling.
MMIO decode shall reach every declared firmware-visible register field.
Model request outputs shall be driven only when the controller has a valid control decision to request physics-based surrogate evaluation.
Model response inputs shall be consumed only through the declared response ingress path; model_rsp_ready is the controller's explicit outbound acknowledgement.

If vehicle speed is outside the supported band, if sensor_fault or sensor_stale is asserted, if the response times out, or if any other safety check fails, actuator_cmd_valid shall be deasserted and fault_latched shall be asserted.
No fallback command, fallback register, fallback status, fallback controller, substitute command, or fallback-on-reset behavior shall be generated.
History storage shall remain a bulk memory structure through the wrapper and shall not be flattened into registers.
Firmware shall be able to clear the latched fault only through the declared MMIO mechanism and only when the invalid condition no longer persists.

On reset, MMIO response/ready state returns to idle, model request and actuator validity are deasserted, model response ready is held in the safe accept state required by the controller sequencing, history strobes are inactive, configuratio
Expose all software-controlled configuration fields as explicit semantic outputs.
Return coherent read data and ready response for each MMIO transaction.
Preserve readable status for latched fault, safety inhibit, timeout activity, and last command values.
Generate a single-cycle fault clear pulse from the dedicated MMIO write field.
Every declared register shall be reachable through address decode.
All writes shall update only the targeted register fields.
Readback shall reflect the most recent committed register values and live status inputs.
A write to the fault-clear field shall generate a bounded pulse and shall not silently substitute actuator output behavior.
No inaccessible internal state may be represented as software-visible.

All writable configuration outputs return to a safe disabled state; fault clear is deasserted; mmio_ready and mmio_rdata are set to an idle-complete default consistent with the bus protocol; readback status reflects inactive/safe defaults u
Generate external model requests in a bounded and protocol-compliant manner.
Consume external model responses only when valid and ready conditions permit.
Enforce speed band, stale-data, timeout, and sensor-fault checks.
Clamp commands to configured min/max bounds before asserting validity.
Latch faults and expose safety inhibit until cleared by firmware.
Write history entries for recent requests, responses, and command decisions via the SRAM wrapper interface.
If cfg_enable is low, the controller shall inhibit actuator_cmd_valid and shall not emit a substitute command.
If vehicle_speed_mps is outside cfg_min_speed_mps to cfg_max_speed_mps, inhibit command validity and latch fault.
If sensor_valid is low, sensor_fault is high, or sensor_stale is high, inhibit command validity and latch fault.
If the response timeout or stale-data limit is reached before a valid response is accepted, inhibit command validity and latch fault.
If a valid model response produces a command outside cfg_cmd_min/cfg_cmd_max, the command shall be clamped to the configured bounds before validity is asserted.
The controller shall present model_rsp_ready high only when it can accept a response under the current state machine phase.
status_last_cmd_valid, status_last_cmd_data, and status_last_speed_mps shall reflect the most recently accepted bounded command and speed sample.
A firmware write to cfg_fault_clear shall clear the latched fault only when no current invalid condition persists; otherwise the fault shall re-latch if the invalid condition remains.
history_wr_en, history_wr_addr, and history_wr_data shall only access the external SRAM wrapper and shall not be exposed as software-visible registers.

Instantiate the required SRAM macro cell using the declared instance name.
Preserve bulk storage as memory, not registers.
Pass the macro read data back to the controller.
Support synchronous access under the top-level clock and reset.
Keep the memory contract neutral to FPGA mapping while remaining compatible with block RAM inference or native macro binding.
The wrapper shall connect exactly to the declared SRAM macro name and instance.
The wrapper shall not flatten the memory into registers.
The wrapper shall not provide substitute memory behavior if the macro is unavailable in the downstream implementation flow.
The wrapper shall keep dout consumed by the controller via a real port connection.

On reset, memory access strobes are deasserted and outputs are held benign; the wrapper does not clear stored contents unless the underlying macro implementation does so implicitly. No alternate storage or fallback register array is created
